title: RARM: Confidence-Gated Progress Reward Modeling for RL in Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2606.22027v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning for robot manipulation is often bottlenecked by reward design, especially in long-horizon tasks: sparse success rewards provide weak supervision, while hand-crafted dense rewards are tedious to design and generalize poorly across tasks. Progress-based reward models offer a promising alternative by estimating how far an observation has advanced toward task completion, but existing approaches often require task-specific demonstrations or progress labels, and can assign high rewards to visually plausible but physically incorrect states. We introduce the Reference-Anchored Reward Model (RARM), a lightweight visual comparator that converts a single successful demonstration into a dense, progress-aware reward. RARM is trained once on general-purpose videos with a contrastive temporal objective, requiring no robot-specific data, task-specific reward labels, or per-task reward engineering. translated_title: RARM：用于操作任务强化学习的置信度门控进度奖励建模
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.22027v3 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：机器人操作的强化学习常常受限于奖励设计，尤其是在长时程任务中：稀疏的成功奖励提供弱监督，而手工设计的稠密奖励既繁琐又难以跨任务泛化。基于进度的奖励模型通过估计观测状态相对于任务完成的推进程度提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但现有方法通常需要特定任务的演示或进度标签，并且可能对视觉上合理但物理上不正确的状态赋予高奖励。我们引入了参考锚定奖励模型（RARM），一种轻量级视觉比较器，可将单个成功演示转换为稠密、进度感知的奖励。RARM在通用视频上使用对比时间目标进行一次性训练，无需机器人特定数据、任务特定奖励标签或每任务奖励工程。在部署时，RARM通过置信度门控机制匹配参考锚定，仅在高置信度时提供进度奖励，从而避免对错误状态的误奖励。
tldr: RARM通过一个轻量级视觉比较器将单个成功演示转化为稠密进度奖励，并采用置信度门控机制，无需任务特定数据或奖励工程，解决了长时程操作任务中的奖励设计瓶颈。
en_tdlr: RARM converts a single successful demonstration into dense progress rewards using a lightweight visual comparator with confidence gating, eliminating task-specific data or reward engineering to address reward design bottlenecks in long-horizon manipulation tasks.
